result.Method of Attack: Automated deployment of Monero mining program using GitHub Action to create Replit accounts, instantiate Replit environments, clone mining program repositories, and start mining
result.Discoverer: 奇安信星图实验室供应链安全团队
result.Attack Vector: GitHub Action automated workflow triggering Python scripts; Exploitation of Replit free online IDE environment without email verification; Cloning malicious git repositories containing mining software and scripts
